name: PackDocuments
title: Pack Documents
description: List every document a pack holds, with what each is and its date: the inventory, never a search
whenToUse: Know what a set of documents holds before asking it anything: which documents a fund's pack has, of what kind, dated when, and so what is missing or older than a year. Give it the pack's folder and get every document back, none ranked and none cut off. It lists; it does not read or answer, and it lists only the pack it is given.

outputs.name: documents
outputs.description: Every document in the pack, by title: { id, title, objectType, reportType, kind, subject, asOf, address }

outputs.name: count
outputs.description: How many documents the pack holds

outputs.name: text
outputs.description: The list as lines a model can read, one document each with its type and date

index.title: Pack
index.description: The pack's folder, the same key its index was built under, e.g. a fund pack's folder

authRequired.title: Require sign-in
authRequired.description: Only a signed-in caller may run this step. Leave off and it runs for whoever the workflow's trigger admitted, which is the usual answer.

authRole.title: Require role
authRole.description: A claim the caller's account must carry, as noun:verb (finance:approve, payments:refund). Leave blank to require only that they are signed in.

package.name: documents
package.packageFile:
# DOCUMENTS — the platform's own document service (services/documents, a Python service beside
# umap): a file in, its structure out. Text in reading order, every table as rows, every figure
# as an image with its caption, every ordered list, the dates a document carries, and where on
# which page each sits. docs/unoverse/data/documents/README.md.
#
# ONE DOOR, ONE NODE: ParseDocument, RenderDocument, InventoryFolder, ReadCover, ReadValues. Each is a JOB on
# the service (start, poll, collect), which is the LlamaParse shape, so the poll capability does
# the waiting. A door does one job, so one can be improved or replaced without touching what
# calls it: a census before reading, a cover before filing, a parse when the whole is wanted.
#
# THE HOST IS THE ENGINE, at loopback (`scope.engineUrl`, :4101), which forwards to the service
# (routes/documents.ts) the way it reaches umap. A node's call must be https or loopback
# (allowedHosts.ts refuses a plaintext request to any other host), and a compose service on the
# Docker network is neither; the engine holds the service's address so no node and no file does.

name: documents
displayName: Documents
description: >-
  Read a file into its structure with the platform's document service. Text, tables as rows,
  figures, lists, dates, provenance
version: 0.1.0
category: ingest
logoUrl: https://res.cloudinary.com/sonik/image/upload/v1751366180/gravity/icons/gravityIcon.png

features:
  - Parse PDF, Word, slides, spreadsheets, HTML and images into one typed structure
  - Tables as rows with units parsed, figures as images, ordered lists as steps
  - Render any page or region as an image
  - "Inventory a folder: kinds, pages, dates, duplicates"
  - "Read a cover: what each file is about and the date it states, from named cells, no model"
  - "Read values: the figures a parsed document stated, refused whole when they do not add up to what it says about itself"

allowedHosts:
  # LOOPBACK ONLY, numeric form (the pattern rejects a bare "localhost"): every call goes to the
  # engine's own listener, which forwards to the service. No third-party host, ever.
  - 127.0.0.1

requires:
  executorVersion: ">=1.6.0"
  transport: [json]
  # Every door is a job: without `poll` an executor would settle on the receipt and emit the job
  # id as the answer.
  poll: true

files.api/events.yaml:
# One row per output connector, in interface.yaml order. `response` is { index, count, documents }.

- emit: documents
  value: "return (response && response.documents) || []"

- emit: count
  value: "return Number((response && response.count) || 0)"

- emit: text
  value: >-
    return ((response && response.documents) || []).map(d =>
      '- ' + d.title + (d.reportType || d.kind ? ' (' + (d.reportType || d.kind) + ')' : '') + (d.asOf ? ', as of ' + d.asOf : '') + (d.subject ? ', about ' + d.subject : '') + ' [' + d.id + ']'
    ).join('\n')
files.api/run.yaml:
# THE LIST of a pack's documents, from the engine at loopback (package.yaml says why). Nothing is
# ranked and nothing is cut off (docs/unoverse/data/documents/search-index.md, "The list").

- name: list
  method: POST
  url: "return scope.engineUrl + '/index/documents'"
  transport: json

  body:
    index: "{{ config.index }}"

  timeoutMs: 30000

  error:
    when: "return !!response.error"
    message: "return response.error"
files.config.yaml:
configSchema:
  type: object
  required: [index]
  properties:
    index:
      type: string
      title: Pack
      description: The pack's folder, the same key its index was built under, e.g. a fund pack's folder
      default: ""
      "ui:field": template
"ui:order": [index]
files.interface.yaml:
inputs: []

outputs:
  - name: documents
    type: array
    description: "Every document in the pack, by title: { id, title, objectType, reportType, kind, subject, asOf, address }"
  - name: count
    type: number
    description: How many documents the pack holds
  - name: text
    type: string
    description: The list as lines a model can read, one document each with its type and date

credentials: []
files.node.yaml:
type: PackDocuments
kind: PromiseNode

name: Pack Documents
category: Documents
color: "#0F766E"
logoUrl: https://res.cloudinary.com/sonik/image/upload/v1751366180/gravity/icons/gravityIcon.png

description: >-
  List every document a pack holds, with what each is and its date: the inventory, never a search

# Outcome first, disqualify by PROPERTY, never name another node.
whenToUse: >-
  Know what a set of documents holds before asking it anything: which documents a fund's pack
  has, of what kind, dated when, and so what is missing or older than a year. Give it the pack's
  folder and get every document back, none ranked and none cut off. It lists; it does not read
  or answer, and it lists only the pack it is given.

auth:
  required: false

capabilities:
  # A pack's list changes with every run that reads a document; never served from memory.
  cacheable: false
files.test.yaml:
# Runs against the platform's own engine and database: a pack that holds nothing lists nothing.
testData:
  config:
    index: "test://pack-documents/empty"
  expect:
    documents: "return Array.isArray(output.documents) && output.documents.length === 0"
    count: "return output.count === 0"
    text: "return output.text === ''"
